title: NeMo Eval Author aggregate audit coverage report
description: Aggregate coverage report built from one audit denominator and many per-trace coverage.json files.

schema.description: Version marker for the aggregate audit coverage report format.

audit.description: Audit spec metadata for the denominator used by this aggregate report.

input_reports.description: Per-trace coverage files included in this aggregate report.

coverage.description: Overall and per-kind aggregate count summaries.

covered.description: Stable audit item names covered by at least one input report.

uncovered.description: Stable audit item names not covered by any input report.

uncovered_items.description: Uncovered audit items formatted as direct input to a future task-generation step.

nonEmptyString.description: String value that must contain at least one non-whitespace character.

itemName.description: Stable machine-readable audit item, method, source, or tool name.

pathString.description: Local file or directory path recorded as a string.

itemCounts.description: Audit item counts keyed by item kind.

audit.description: Identity, review state, and counts for the audit denominator.

path.description: Path to the audit.md file aggregated against.

schema.description: Schema version of the audit denominator.

agent.description: Agent name declared by the audit denominator.

status.description: Review state of the audit denominator when this report was produced.

item_count.description: Total number of audit items in the denominator.

subject.description: Provider-neutral identity of one measured task/run artifact.

trace.description: Path to the interaction trace that was measured.

trace_format.description: Trace serialization format understood by the measurement method.

task_id.description: Stable task, scenario, or case identifier for grouping measurements.

run_id.description: Identifier for the specific run, trial, attempt, or repetition measured.

inputReport.description: Compact summary of one input coverage.json file included in aggregation.

item_kind_count.description: Denominator for this input report's item kind.

covered_count.description: Number of item names covered by this input report.

countSummary.description: Coverage counts for a denominator subset.

evidenceList.description: Evidence predicates copied from the uncovered audit item.

uncoveredItem.description: One uncovered audit item, preserving the original audit item and adding generation-oriented context.

reason.description: Why this item appears in the uncovered list.

description.description: Description copied from the audit item.

source_refs.description: Source references copied from the audit item, or an empty list.

generation.description: Compact context a downstream task generator can use to close this gap.

focus.description: One-sentence target behavior or failure condition to exercise.

needed_tools.description: Declared tool names likely needed to generate a task for this gap.

audit_item.description: Original validated audit item copied verbatim for kind-specific generation details.
